Fixed in updateQuorumNumerator and unknown40e8c5cb ('SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 32 bits'), addContender (0xc6cd9b06, x, address(y)), castVote..BySig (0x62d524b0); ProposalCreated is decoded (2369). createElection's 2 raw reverts remain.
VoteCastWithParams now prints reason=Array(len=reason.length, ..) and params=Array(len=params.length, ..) (1511-1517 and the BySig copy).
createElection now 'return _214'; state, electionIndexToDescription, getProposeArgs unchanged; hashProposal worse (regression 2).
quorum's mem[_40] read and duplicated arms unchanged.
mem[172 len 20] (28 lines) and the 4 Bytes(16, 0x..) selector fragments unchanged.
usedNonces key is now sha3(sha3(Bytes(2, 0x1901), domain separator, struct hash), Bytes(20, address(signer))) (1576, 1581).

regressions.source: Governor.execute: state checks (require ... 'Governor: proposal not successful'), _execute -> cohortSize(), custom errors, emit ProposalExecuted(proposalId), return proposalId
regressions.issue: The whole tail of execute (inside the encoding loop's exit branch) lost the free-memory pointer: 8 string/custom-error reverts, 2 call names, the event argument, 3 storage names and the return value fall back to raw memory. Effects are all still there and text_check finds no difference.
regressions.rule: A read of mem[64] right after mem[64] = x is x inside loop bodies and their exit branches too; better, print code that only runs after a loop's exit after the loop (finding 1) so it is not treated as loop-variant.
regressions.verified: reading only (text_check run --per-selector 32: 0 different, the tail is likely unsampled)

regressions.decompiled: mem[64] = v / mem[v] = sha3(mem[_28 + 32 len mem[_28]]) / return memory from mem[64] len v - mem[64] + 32
regressions.old: mem[v] = sha3(mem[mem[64] + 32 len mem[mem[64]]]) / return memory from v len 32
regressions.source: Governor.hashProposal: return uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(targets, values, calldatas, descriptionHash)))
regressions.issue: Same cause: the read of mem[64] just after 'mem[64] = v' is not v, so the length stays 'v - mem[64] + 32' (finding 5 worse here).
regressions.rule: Same as above; then return of mem[p len 32] after mem[p] = x is return x.

improvements: VoteCastWithParams' two dynamic fields split right (finding 3), usedNonces key resolved (finding 8), SafeCast and custom-error reverts decoded in 4 functions, ProposalCreated decoded field by field, createElection returns its id, updateQuorumNumerator 55 -> 33 and addContender 121 -> 76 lines. P6 3 -> 0.
notes: Diff 1284 lines: per-function diffs of execute, hashProposal; effects compared for all 10 changed functions (counts equal everywhere). P4 4 -> 9 comes from execute's proposalSnapshot[concat(mem[0])]. text_check run --per-selector 32 (r2): empty 1571 same, random 1571 same, 0 different.
summary: Three round-1 findings fixed (event split, nonce key, most raw reverts), but execute's tail, nested in a loop exit, lost the free-pointer tracking: its reverts, two calls, an event argument and the return fall back to raw memory (medium).
